Secular trends in adolescent sleep duration

Methods. We pooled survey data from 12 countries collected between 1990 and 2010.

Results. Between 1990 and 2010, mean sleep duration among adolescents fell by 18 minutes per night in the pooled sample. The decline was larger on school nights than on weekends. Weekend sleep duration was largely unchanged.

Discussion. These findings suggest that adolescents now sleep less than previous generations, although self-report bias may affect the estimates.
